what: Provenance overlay for ART-025. CAPTURE FILES ARE NOT EDITED — they are a published artifact and immutable. This records what could be recovered and, more importantly, what could not.
rule: Recovery is TRANSCRIPTION ONLY. A value is recorded here when it exists somewhere in the capture under a different key or inside a URL. Locale was NOT inferred from the language of the captured text: English content is evidence of a served language, not a record of one, and the whole reason D-004 exists is that the American Airlines sweep proved a guess about locale can invert a finding.
